(I)--the son of नाहुषि (Aurva) and father of Jamadagni by सत्यवती; the sage who married गाधि's daughter by paying a price of a thousand white horses with one black ear. (See सत्यवती). A मन्त्रकृत्
1: भा. IX. १५. 5-११; Br. II. १३. ९५; ३२. १०४; III. 1. ९५; २५. ८३.
com- pared to धिष्णि fire. Blessed his wife with a चरु and his mother-in-law with another for the birth res- pectively of a ब्राह्मण and a क्षत्रिय son. His wife wrongly took that intended for her mother. She gave birth to Jamadagni and became converted as कौशिकी river;
2: Br. III. २१. १९-22: ६६. ३७-40; IV. 7. १३, ३४; वा. ६५. ९३; ९१. ६६-86.
father of two other sons शुनह्शेप and शुनह्पुच्छ;
3: वा. ९१. ६६. ९२; Br. III. ६६. ६४.
had १०० sons who in turn had १००० sons--all भार्गवस्.
4: वा. ६५. ९२-95.
[page१-262+ २६]
(II)--a son of शिखण्डि; an अवतार् in the eighteenth द्वापर। वा. २३. १८३.
(III)--a son of सुतार the lord of the second द्वापर। वा. २३. १२१.
--the sage presiding over the month of इष। भा. XII. ११. ४३.
